subject: Request: short-term auditor SSO & proxy token rotation
messages:
From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@sigma-audit.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 12:03:00 -0500
Subject: Request: brief SSO window + proxy token rotation

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for continuing to coordinate with us. We're starting our scheduled evidence collection for SigmaCorp's SOC 2 Type II window next week and need two things from Redwood to avoid a workflow delay:

1) A short extension (48–72 hrs) on the current trust portal session for our lead reviewer, Claire Huang (claire.huang@sigma-audit.com). The current link we received expires in ~36 hours and their team is in APAC — shifting the window would prevent an extra round-trip.

2) Guidance or a mechanism to rotate the ephemeral proxy access token used by external auditors (we require one-time tokens to be rotated every 24 hours). Can you confirm whether Redwood can rotate the token and issue a fresh one-time SSO artifact, or if we should rely on our side to re-request a session? If rotation requires specific IP allowlist entries, please list the addresses we should provide.

If helpful, we can do a quick 15-minute call today to unblock.

Appreciate it — we want to avoid rescheduling any evidence pulls.

Best,
Claire Huang
Senior Auditor, Sigma Audit Partners
claire.huang@sigma-audit.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: none
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@sigma-audit.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 13:10:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief SSO window + proxy token rotation

Claire — thanks for the heads up. We can support both requests; details below.

1) Session extension: I will issue a one-time session link that is valid for 72 hours from the time of activation and scoped to read-only downloads. The new link will be single-use and will expire immediately after the first successful session termination or after 72 hours, whichever comes first.

2) Proxy token rotation: Redwood can rotate the ephemeral proxy token on our side. We will: 
  - Generate a fresh token and bind it to the auditor's email (claire.huang@sigma-audit.com)
  - Restrict the token to the requested download scopes and S3-prefetch endpoints
  - Configure token TTL to 24 hours and provide a rotation endpoint if you need another token after expiry

IP allowlist: if you prefer IP-based locking, please provide the egress IPs you expect from Sigma Audit. Typical entries customers provide look like: 34.204.12.0/24, 13.59.0.0/16 — we can accept either CIDR ranges or single IPs.

Next steps: I'll coordinate with our ops team to generate the one-time link and run the proxy rotation. Marissa and Karthik are looped for audit logging and token rotation steps. Expect an internal coordination note shortly and then the external session link.

Document attachments I'm including: redacted_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (read-only) and a short bridge_letter_2027-12-01.pdf we prepared in case the reviewer needs a scope confirmation.

If you want a call, I'm free 3–4pm ET today.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Manager, Trust & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.ai | +1 617-555-0123

Attachments:
- redacted_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (PDF, ~2.4MB, redacted financials)
- bridge_letter_2027-12-01.pdf (PDF, attestation + audit window)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 15:02:00 -05:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Proxy token rotation + session issuance for Sigma audit (Claire Huang)

Marissa / Karthik —

Quick ask to coordinate the rotation and logging:

- Marissa: can you create the one-time session at https://trust.redwood.ai/admin/sessions and scope it to reviewer:claire.huang@sigma-audit.com with read-only + download=true? Please tag the session with external_audit=Sigma_2027 and set expiry to 72 hours.

- Karthik: we'll need the rotation script run to produce a fresh proxy token, TTL=24h, bound to the session id. Can you execute the rotation and drop the token into the secure vault (rotation job id prefixed sigma-rot-20271201)? Also, please capture the audit log entry for token issuance and token binding.

I'm attaching a tiny helper script for the rotation; it handles the vault write and the session binding. Feel free to rework if needed. We'll need a quick confirmation back once both steps are done so I can send the external link.

Thanks — aiming to turn this around within an hour.

Aisha

Attachments:
- proxy_rotation_script.sh (bash script, 12 lines)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@sigma-audit.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 18:35:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: brief SSO window + proxy token rotation

Claire —

All set. Below is the one-time session link and usage details. Please only activate from the location listed in your opener (APAC region) to avoid geo-based rate limits we sometimes see when sessions are started from multiple regions.

One-time session link (single-use): https://trust.redwood.ai/session/one-time/eyJhbGci...
Session expires: 72 hours from first activation; token TTL: 24 hours from issuance.
Allowed scopes: evidence:read, evidence:download (zip, pdflatex), audit_log:read
Attached: bridge_letter_2027-12-01.pdf (attestation), redacted_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (read-only)

IP allowlist (optional): 34.204.12.0/24, 52.46.0.0/16

If you hit the link and it fails, reply here immediately and we'll generate a second single-use token. We recorded the rotation job as sigma-rot-20271201 and the issuance is audited (entry id: audit-20271201-9032).

Thanks and good luck with the pull — let me know if you need any additional extracts (S3 prefetch manifests or expanded activity logs).

Best,
Aisha Rahman
